name: 反応数と続きの返信を持つ会話
prompt:
Create a clean, compact UI image matching the Japanese native preview at exactly a 390x170 aspect ratio. Use the native preview as the authority for localized wording, colors, and layout; use the original Instagram crop for context and the prior blue-link sample only as a hyperlink color cue.

Exact visible text: 2週間前, こんにちは。きっと大丈夫です。, またお話ししましょう。, 32, さらに11件の返信を見る. Show the mint circular avatar with 山. Place the gray timestamp above the pale mint rounded reply bubble. Keep the two-line comment dark. Beneath the bubble, preserve the small pale-mint reaction pill with a forest-green outline heart and dark count 32. Keep the thin elbow-shaped reply connector and its current position.

The clickable text さらに11件の返信を見る is a hyperlink action and must be blue #1976D2 per the user’s explicit direction. Keep every other text dark or muted gray/green according to the Japanese preview. Do not color the timestamp, comment, or reaction count blue. No underlines are needed.

Match the native preview’s compact geometry: avatar near x16/y21 at 32px; timestamp near x68/y6; bubble x64/y28 at about 286x80; reply text x79; reaction pill centered under the bubble around y96; connector at x29; more-replies link at x64/y142. White background, no outer card or shadow. Preserve all text exactly; do not add words or icons. Output only the component.
